about: module aws's mutants (wf10 GEN-EMIT): each is judged by the module's laws (scripts/examples -modules aws). A mutant of the generated s3.ergo stands for an emitter bug that writes that text; the emitter's own mutants are in modules/clientgen/testdata/mutants.json, killed there or by the drift case examples/clientgen/cases/s3-current. The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: emit-label-not-greedy
mutants.from: Method: "HEAD", Path: "/" + r.Bucket + "/" + r.Key, RawPath: "/" + aws.Label(r.Bucket, false) + "/" + aws.Label(r.Key, true),
mutants.to: Method: "HEAD", Path: "/" + r.Bucket + "/" + r.Key, RawPath: "/" + aws.Label(r.Bucket, false) + "/" + aws.Label(r.Key, false),
mutants.rule: A {Key+} label keeps each '/' as a path separator, each segment escaped once: SlashesStayInThePath (drawn keys hold '/'). S3 decodes %2F to the same key, so ApiIsTheFake cannot see it; SigV4 signs the path as sent.

mutants.name: emit-header-dropped
mutants.rule: Each output header is read: ApiIsTheFake (the fake's GetObject gives an ETag; the Api read over the handler must too).

mutants.name: emit-error-code-swapped
mutants.rule: Each error code is read as its own failure: ApiIsTheFake (the fake fails GetObject with NoSuchKey for a missing key and InvalidObjectState for an archived one).

mutants.name: emit-prefix-headers-lost
mutants.rule: PutObject sends its x-amz-meta-* headers: PutThenGetIsThePayload over the Api (and ApiIsTheFake).

mutants.name: aws-signer-skipped
mutants.rule: Every request the net gets went through the signer once: KeyOnlyInTheNet (here HeadObject sends its request unsigned). The key itself never reaches the Api: it is an http.Credential of the Net (std http's own law CredentialPassesUnseen).

mutants.name: aws-head-404-unnamed
mutants.rule: An error answer with no body (a HEAD) gets its status's name as its code, so HeadObject's 404 is NotFound: ApiIsTheFake.

mutants.name: aws-recording-below-signer
mutants.rule: A recording sits above the signer, so it holds no signature: RecordingSitsAboveTheSigner (here the recording keeps the signed request).

mutants.name: aws-wire-unknown-storage-class-dropped
mutants.rule: An unknown x-amz-storage-class wire value is kept as StorageClassOther as declared; dropping it to StorageClassStandard fails S3ClientWireLaws.

mutants.name: aws-put-by-drops-value
mutants.rule: PutBy writes under exact field name when present: PutRoundTrips and S3ClientOptionalWireMembers catch corrupting the field name.

mutants.name: aws-put-text-appends-on-none
mutants.to:
case option.Some{x}:
		out = out.Append(http.Field{Name: name, Value: x})
	case option.None:
		out = out.Append(http.Field{Name: name, Value: ""})
	}
	out
}
mutants.rule: PutText must append nothing when v is None: PutRoundTrips verifies field count stays unchanged on None.

mutants.name: aws-put-int-dropped
mutants.rule: PutInt encodes integer header/query options via IntText: PutRoundTrips and S3ClientOptionalWireMembers catch dropping it.

mutants.name: aws-put-time-wrong-format
mutants.from: out = out.Append(http.Field{Name: name, Value: TimeText(t, f)})
mutants.to: out = out.Append(http.Field{Name: name, Value: TimeText(t, HTTPDate)})
mutants.rule: PutTime must respect the Format f (HTTPDate, DateTime, EpochSeconds): PutRoundTrips and S3ClientOptionalWireMembers fail if f is ignored.

mutants.name: aws-same-outcome-ignores-err-mismatch
mutants.to:
case again:
			return sameErr(again, e) || true
mutants.rule: SameOutcome must compare failures with sameErr when both runs fail: SameOutcomeChecksEquality fails when unequal errors report true.

mutants.name: emit-put-int-header-dropped
mutants.rule: PutObject sends optional Content-Length via aws.PutInt: S3ClientOptionalWireMembers inspects the outgoing HTTP request headers.
